response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks direct executive leadership experience, fintech-specific domain knowledge, and a proven track record in scaling engineering teams or architecting production-grade multi-agent AI systems in regulated environments.
strengths: Diverse technical background with hands-on experience in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and AI-agent tooling (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq).
Proven ability to work across the stack and select appropriate technologies (e.g., TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) for high-performance applications.
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement, demonstrating passion for scalable, testable, and observable systems.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current and past roles are primarily individual contributor or senior developer positions.
Limited evidence of direct experience in fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit systems, real-time risk modeling) or regulated AI environments.
Multi-agent AI experience appears to be in early-stage or tooling contexts, not production-scale systems with financial consequences.
